acceptance: A reviewed, documented emergency procedure exists; the develop ruleset shows zero bypass actors again with enforcement active.
context: Incident 2026-10-14: a stale scope-ledger entry failed every PR's comment gate. Repair PR #2953 could not merge normally (gate pins the base copy) and the develop-squash-only ruleset listed zero bypass actors, so even admin API merge was refused. Resolved with owner approval via temporary org-admin pull_request bypass, immediate merge, and verified restore.
description: There is no standing break-glass path for base-pinned gate breakage: with zero bypass actors, the next all-PR-blocking outage requires improvising repo security changes under pressure again. Record the emergency procedure (temporary org-admin pull_request bypass, merge, immediate verified restore) or pre-approve a standing break-glass actor, with the exact commands and verification checks, and get it reviewed before the next incident.
